A desolate land where time flows chaotically. Guided by the Blazing Feather, with the universe as the chessboard and stars as the pieces, the chosen one reaches out to touch the distant past beneath the Eternal Blaze.

The distorted copy of the painting has created a realm of illusion through the artist's Forte. Her deeply rooted negative emotions have corroded its colors and brought powerful Tacet Discords to life.
A mysterious stained-glass mirror made of energy crystals.\nCome closer. Gaze into me, fix your eyes upon me, until your soul is laid bare—not to the "mirror," but to me.

Reality and destiny fades; Constructions and laws collapsed. Chaos consumed all in the blazing flame, only pain and agony remain.

The vault houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Upholding the principle of "Inviolability of Property," it is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.
Phrolova's Sonoro Sphere. \nAmid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
A mysterious entrance opened amidst the Dark Tide, where the surging currents converge.
Entrance to the Underground Exhibition Hall

A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.
Maiden's tear was caged within the whispering forest. Her soul was forever detained and was tormented by scarlet thorns, which were nurtured by endless malice.
This Sonoro Sphere preserves the moonlit forest as it was before the Tacet Field consumed it. That same light also created the terrifying nightmare on the second night.
Laws and orders have crumbled, uprooting reality and destiny.\nPlease heed our words. One more step closer, and you shall break free.
The Temporal Loop, an arena of destiny, beckons for you again.\nThe deity that wields heavenly might patiently awaits a fated battle.
This Sonoro Sphere captures the sunlight shed upon the forest. When day and night collide, it condenses into an eternal crystal of flame.
A mysterious space in the Crownless Statue's heart, where chaotic flames of war are born.
Lingering frequencies left by a fierce clash between two formidable forces, now shaped by your memories and taking the form of Lycrosis.\nThe singer from beyond still awaits on the stage.
A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes.
A prison hangs in the heavens, devouring glory from the past. Upon the divine throne covered in thorns, she waits for her demise.

The Threnodian Leviathan merged unto a Kingdom the memories, feelings, and aspirations of all Rinascitans, assimilating their thoughts and erasing their obsessions. An immaculate Paradise drawn on bewildered souls, whose lifeless forms chant in unison, day and night—for naught but to earn Its grace and redemption.
In the depths of the stars' memories, a mech waits in silence for the moment of its return. \nListen once more to the sighs of hope, pain, concern, and grief, then cleave the eternal shackles.
A shadow from the past, born when the "truth" touched nothingness, drifting endlessly in this boundless ocean of void.\nGo to her. Call out her name. Do not let her be alone.

The Public Security Bureau has set up this room to resolve civil conflicts. Here, disputing parties can debate, mediate, and negotiate, making conflict resolution more efficient and occasionally assisting in major case investigations.
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.

The Beyond—that promised perfection—is no more in this world, at least for now. Yet deep beneath the sea, its broken fragments still glimmer with echoes of old obsession and hope. Whenever you return, you'll hear joyful laughter of rebirth, as if this land still holds the promise of eternity.

The Spacetrek Collective Research Institute is a borderless research facility, where scientists from around the world study the Exostrider and the Stridergate. It also serves as the R&D center of the artificial sun, Helios. Standing at the highest point in Lahai-Roi, the Institute is built on an orbit track alongside the Starward Riseway, continuously monitoring the Exostrider's great sword. Over the years, countless researchers have devoted their lives and wisdom here, all in the hope that humanity's torch of exploration will forever burn bright.

The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records.\nWith each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider.

Startorch Academy offers every student a private dorm room to relax and recharge. Every space in the building is thoughtfully designed to meet a variety of needs. The resting area creates a calming environment that helps even insomniacs drift off with ease. Soundproofed walls minimize noise complaints, ensuring peace of mind.
This Sonoro Sphere captures the never-ending din of countless engines, a constant soundtrack to the bustling metropolis that was once drenched in molten metal.
This Sonoro Sphere captures the essence of dawn and dusk, as a fiery crystal sparks through the forest, illuminating its surroundings in a blaze of light.
This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. In a darkness untouched by day or night, can a single glimmer of light deliver what the heart yearns for?

It reveals the Academy's final moments, where Void Storms creep in like a black fog, smothering everything in the dead of night. In this deathly stillness, the Academy stands as a grim testament to the prophecy for civilizations—All that is known shall eventually be erased by the unknown.
In the wake of the Void Storm, the Academy lies in ruins. Desks and instruments drift like ghosts on a dead tide. Silence reigns. When will the next roll call sound? Perhaps no one is left to know.
The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.

The Heliogyre, corrupted by Voidmatter, becomes a twisted core of energy that unleashes a calamity of "light." Where light touches, people and Exoswarm are reduced to nothingness, as if they had never existed.
The wise man knows that everything is false, but the wise man will substitute the false for the true, and will learn the lessons of the real battle from the virtual scenarios.

But it is not a solution found from the outside; rather, it lies within the depths of the past, the boundless potential of the future, and your very own heart.

Here concentrate the spotlight of the world, and beneath the light are the truths await uncovered by the brave. Or maybe the answer is always in your heart.

The clever consider all to be fake, while the wise turns falsity into veracity. The same applies to virtual training.

An institution where the Order sealed all forbidden books and records, now lost beneath the depths of the lake during the Dark Tide.

John Wicktorio, a retired acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.\nDetermined to settle the score and avenge his old friend, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.

[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.
